outcome: presence and quantities of cariogenic and periodontal pathogens in the oral cavity
cohort: 69 one-year-old infants (24 pre-term with very low birthweights and 45 full-term)
finding: Full-term infants had a higher prevalence of Streptococcus mutans compared to pre-term infants, while both groups showed a high prevalence of other cariogenic and periodontal pathogens by 12 months of age.
mod_finding: Mode of delivery was considered as a factor but no specific findings related to it were reported.
